answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond in 3 layers; an opal seal binds one key to one identity. The comet record proves fresh signed work, and no layer is shareable. Auditors sample one layer per epoch and check the saffron receipt on the public log; a failed layer burns the bond. First fake 50, k-th 50+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 4,046,000 for a 40,000 pool. A rented-layer ring fails on a borrowed seal. Honest agents pay 50 once, keeping the reward.
